summary: Union Street kerb beside car park and oval, homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto car park and oval

drivers.seclusion: North side is a car park then an oval with trees; nearest homes 21-25 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street with a parked row on this side; room to stop at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban street; passing cars only.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this kerb in the QLD image, so a van blends in.

flags: Slope about 3% here, steeper downhill to east (up to 8.4%)
Toowong Creek 102 m away; elevation 12-14 m
sun_shade: Mostly open; large tree shades the east end of the section, oval open to the north.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is locked at night

best_section.where: north kerb between the car park exit and the big tree, beside the oval
